title: ECOLUXE Pre-Emmys Endless Summer Festival Returns to Beverly Hills - NewsBreak
text:
By Ariel Johns ,
23 hours ago On Friday, September 11 th , acclaimed producer Debbie Durkin hosted her annual exclusive ECOLUXE Endless Summer Festival, in the heart of Emmys week. Held during the 78 th Primetime Emmy Awards celebration, the invitation-only, curated affair gathers an elite crowd of nominees, Olympians, pro athletes, television and film stars , and entertainment industry leaders to celebrate television’s brightest stars with purpose, sustainability and community to benefit Wagmor Pets Dog Rescue.
Acclaimed producer Debbie Durkin hosts her annual exclusive ECOLUXE Endless Summer Festival, in the heart of Emmys week. (Photo credit: Vivien Killilea/Getty Images for Debbie Durkin’s ECOLUXE Lounge) Talent and VIPS arrived with Getty Images photo coverage and posed for summer portraits with beloved celebrity photographer David Christopher Lee. This warm day was fueled by oxygen-rich Patriox Water, keeping guests energized through the busy celebrations of television’s biggest night. Guests discovered College Girl Cherished, beautiful monthly care boxes to send love, spiritual support, and self care to your girls’ dorm and received wellness treatments from Relax Sauna, the precision far-infrared portal sauna using proprietary technology that supports detoxification, speed recovery, reduce stress, chronic illness support and to improve overall well-being, recommended by practitioners worldwide. Delighted guests met 5 yr. old entrepreneur Aria, creator of Colors by Aria, a color changing lip oil Ari Heart. Libertad Vida Beauty, founded by former cosmetic chemist, Esme, hosted an interactive “Make your own Lip Gloss Bar’ that was a guest favorite. Guests savored on elevated eats from Petros on Sunset, and Strictly Vegan’s refreshing mango salsa. The Jamaica Tourism Board showcased their island home and gifted their infamous Blue Mountain Coffee. My Best Bud, a patented pet wellness cannabis brand based in California, was educating and gifting their science-based CBD pet products. West Hollywood’s ROSS Massage promoted corrective bodywork helping guests correct how they feel and move. Guests walked away with a signature gift bag curated by Honey & Stone Beauty, Marci’s Pet Kitchen dog treats, Fayah Streetwear Sunglasses, ettitude luxury bamboo bedding and ECOLUXE merch. DJ Paxy kept the party hoppin’.
(L-R) Juju Brener and Mila Brener, of ‘Guns & Moses’, and Shirly Brener along with Porscha Coleman of ‘Divorced Sistas’ attend the ECOLUXE Endless Summer Festival on September 11, 2026 in Beverly Hills, California. (Photo credit: Vivien Killilea/Getty Images for Debbie Durkin’s ECOLUXE Lounge) (L-R) Jesse Kove of ‘Cobra Kai’ (w ith furry friends available for foster and/or adoptions through Wagmor Pets), and Gilles Marini of ‘Dancing With the Stars’/ ‘ Sex and the City’ attend the ECOLUXE Endless Summer lounge on September 11, 2026 in Beverly Hills, California. (Photo credit: Vivien Killilea/Getty Images for Debbie Durkin’s ECOLUXE Lounge)
This unforgettable afternoon supported rescue efforts through Wagmor Pets Dog Rescue with dogs on site for foster and/or adoption, continuing on the beloved Emmy Week tradition known for its authentic celebrity hospitality, now in its 19 th year.
About ECOLUXE Lounge Our ECOLUXE experience seamlessly blends luxury, wellness , and purposeful brands with philanthropic initiatives, setting a new standard for meaningful celebrity engagements. By bringing together influential figures and eco-friendly brands, the event serves as a catalyst for change—providing a platform to showcase products that improve the lives of people and pets while supporting sustainable and socially responsible living.
Lifestyle blogger Ariel Johns attends the ECOLUXE Endless Summer Festival on September 11, 2026 in Beverly Hills, California. (Photo credit: Vivien Killilea/Getty Images for Debbie Durkin’s ECOLUXE Lounge) If you would like to learn more about the event or explore opportunities to get involved, please feel free to reach out or connect with us on Instagram and TikTok @producerdeb.
